feeds.title: 35mmc
feeds.description: 35mmc is a complete website about camera, camera reviews, rangefinders, lenses, compact cameras thoughts & experiences. It has cameras from vintage manual focus cameras to auto focus point and shoots and everything in between.

feeds.title: Casual Photophile
feeds.description: At Casual Photophile we review classic cameras and legacy lenses and discuss their continued relevance in the digital age. Find articles on film cameras, digital cameras and photography, lens reviews, tips and techniques, photographer profiles, reviews, retrospectives, and more.

feeds.title: 678 Vintage Camera Blog
feeds.description: Whether you are looking for the experience of a no-frills, fully mechanical SLR, or going full lomo with a plastic point & shoot, or anywhere in between, we have you covered. Our goal is to provide you with quality products and higher quality service to back them up. To that end, every camera, lens, or accessory that we sell has been fully tested and confirmed to function properly before it comes to you.

feeds.title: Kamerastore Blog
feeds.description: At Kamerastore, we have access to the best camera testing equipment available. All items are put through a rigorous testing process to determine their functional quality, and we do our best to accurately represent that information in the listing.

feeds.title: Canny Cameras
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Alan Duncan. I have a growing love of the often neglected Point & Shoot cameras that we all used in the '70s and '80s before the arrival of auto-focus and later digital. I don't claim to be the next Vivien Maier and this blog ain't about me lording my shots but hopefully will be of some help to folk who wanna know more about some of the cameras, film etc I use.

feeds.title: Analog.Cafe
feeds.description: Analog.Cafe is a group effort from 116 contributing writers, artists, and photographers featuring weekly photo essays on art, travel, culture, analogue cameras, film, history, and techniques.

feeds.title: MrLeica
feeds.description: I'm Matt. I'm a self taught photographer with 10+ years experience of photographing portraits, models and weddings. Blog reviews include a combination of technical detail, example images, and side by side comparisons.

feeds.title: Campkins Cameras Blog
feeds.description: We've been helping our customers find the right product and service since 1952. Campkins Cameras is an independent, family-run retail business specialising in the sale of new and second-hand cameras both modern and vintage, binoculars and telescopes.

feeds.title: Mike Eckman » Photography
feeds.description: These articles might be of interest to anyone into vintage photography or collecting cameras but aren't quite a guide or a review. My name is Mike Eckman and I've been running this site for a few years. In late 2014, I had a 're-discovery' of film cameras which took off into directions I never could have imagined. I grew a collection of film cameras made in nearly every decade of the 20th century and started reviewing them.

feeds.title: My Favourite Lens
feeds.description: Hello there. I'm Lee, and I like to do photography with vintage lenses and on film. My Favourite Lens is my place on the internet where I publish that work and give tips on how you can do it too. My Favourite Lens is about giving you the inspiration and information for your own photographic creation.

feeds.title: thegashaus
feeds.description: My name is Mark. I am a geographer, transit data analyst, writer, tinkerer, and collector of cameras. The appeal of vintage cameras was first related to their mechanical nature, actual function was secondary. That quickly changed when I started to run film through them, then started to process my own film. This hobby has quickly snowballed to consume a good amount of time each day, but I wouldn't change a thing.

feeds.title: Victory Camera Blog
feeds.description: We have over twenty years of experience and deep knowledge of film and digital cameras. Our inventory of vintage cameras covers all of the major lines and a variety of budgets, and our main purpose is to help people enjoy photography, whatever their interests or level of experience may be.

feeds.title: Photo Thinking
feeds.description: My name is Theo Panagopoulos, and I have had a fascination with capturing the moment for as long as I remember. Photo Thinking is a friendly and informative blog on photography, photo processes and the wonderful and varied cameras used to create pictures. I have created this purely out of my love of everything related to photography. I blog about analogue photography, film, vintage camera and everything that is a photo.

feeds.title: Aly's Vintage Camera Alley
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Alyssa Chiarello. I started photography when I was 12 years old and now it is a part of me and my pictures are an expression of what I am feeling and going through. I love the lighting, and shadows that express feeling in my photos. All photography is done on film using vintage cameras.

feeds.title: Photography & Vintage Film Cameras
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Mike. I spend much of my time making photographs, usually with old film cameras. A move to Albuquerque at the beginning of 2008 has given my photo work more of an urban character.

feeds.title: UAE Vintage Photo Blog
feeds.description: UAE Vintage Photo was started as a way to build up lens and camera collection a few years back. Now, with over a stock of 350 cameras, lenses and suppliers from all over the globe, UAE is your place to buy speciality lens, cameras in the UAE. Be it Russian or Anamorphic lens, 35mm & medium format cameras, super 8 video cameras, we have got you covered.

feeds.title: Old Camera Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm John Margetts. I am a camera enthusiast who collects old cameras. These are descriptions of my growing collection of old film cameras together with my experience of using them. I do not research the cameras for this blog - I describe a real camera that is sitting in front of me when it is not actually in my hands.

feeds.title: West Yorkshire Cameras Blog
feeds.description: Since 2012, we've been pouring over all the analogue equipment we can get our hands-on - testing, cleaning, fixing, shooting, and finding new homes for it all. We buy & sell all types of classic photographic equipment in-store and online.

feeds.title: Vintage-Photo
feeds.description: Here we follow the quest of more and more creative photographers who want to combine new and old, use classic analogue lenses on their digital cameras for photos and video or even acquire one of the vintage camera's. A site about photography, vintage camera and lenses. But a little bit different by paying more attention to the quality of film cameras.

feeds.title: Japancamerahunter
feeds.description: JapanCameraHunter is a blog on a collection of classic cameras, film photography news and sales, lens and accessory sourcing. Let me help you find the camera of your dreams.

feeds.title: Vintage Camera Online Blog
feeds.description: Vintage Camera Online offers you a wide range of cameras depending on the latest features and functionalities. As a b2b marketplace, we have a large array of updated cameras for you.

feeds.title: Vintage Camera Blog
feeds.description: Nicholas Hacko is a third-generation Master Watchmaker who has been selling and servicing high-grade Swiss watches in Sydney for over 25 years, as well as manufacturing his own line of Australian mechanical watches.
